notes: Matching per prompt_ro_align.md. A: outputs/reference_po_opus.json (50 steps from the Simeria procedure). B: outputs/ledger_public_reverse_opus.json (62 claims, 75 order statements). das_staff, mayor and das_system are one side; citizen, supplier, AJPIS and owners' association are separate sides; ledger 'unknown' may match any side; reference 'other' town-hall compartments (Taxes office, CAPLJ, Economic Directorate) are matched to town-hall/'other'/unknown claims. 'merged' = one ledger claim covers this and at least one other reference step; 'partial' = the claim(s) cover only part of the step or a material part is missing; a ledger split into claims that together equal the step is 'exact'. matched_claim_ids lists the primary claim first. order_checks: (predecessor, step) pairs from the reference predecessor lists, in reference order, where both are matched; all matched claims of each step are used; forward_len/reverse_len are shortest paths (edge count) over the ledger order statements; same_order is true when a forward path exists and is no longer than the reverse path, false when only a reverse path exists or it is shorter, 'not_connected' when neither exists; pairs whose only matched claim is the same claim are skipped.
